estation.name: E-station IC-500-50
not_in_budget: TetrAMM noise term (the low-current flag covers it)

params.closes_with: the beam's real height and width, from a screen or a knife-edge scan
params.name: beam.aspect_central
params.source: beam height / width; the symmetric 1x1 mm slits carry no ratio information; undulator beams are usually wider than tall (MonC's was 33:1)

params.closes_with: the beam's real height and width, from a screen or a knife-edge scan
params.name: beam.aspect_high
params.source: upper end of the beam height / width range: the symmetric slits taken at face value, the conservative case

params.closes_with: the beam's real height and width, from a screen or a knife-edge scan
params.name: beam.aspect_low
params.source: lower end of the beam height / width range for the recombination sensitivity

params.closes_with: the slit distance and the real beam FWHM
params.name: beam.width_mm
params.source: beam width along the plate from the white-beam slit set 2 (1.00 x 1.00 mm in every November window); the slits sit outside the Gaussian hot zone, so this is an upper bound on the beam

params.closes_with: a dark measured the same day
params.name: fx4.dark_sigma_a
params.source: residual dark offset after the caller's dark is subtracted, taken equal to the TetrAMM's (the E-station dark moved by about 1 nA from week to week)

params.closes_with: the order code and its accuracy table, or a calibration against a known current source
params.name: fx4.gain_rel
params.source: gain accuracy placeholder: the FX4 manual's text gives no figure

params.closes_with: a pressure reading on the chamber gas line
params.name: gas.p_kpa
params.source: stand-in: the C-station site-mean pressure; no E-station gas pressure sensor exists (user accepted, 2026-11-14)

params.closes_with: a temperature sensor on the chamber body
params.name: gas.t_c
params.source: the E-hutch air temperature (a degF PV; the live E-station lane reads this PV, user confirmed 2026-11-16: "Yes, keep it"); it is the hutch air, not the chamber body, and no chamber temperature sensor exists (TODO.md)

params.name: ic500.electrode_width_mm
params.source: electrode extent across the beam, 63 mm (user, 2026-11-16, vendor figure of the IC-400/IC-500 -50 split electrode). The wall-loss Monte Carlo assumes plates wide enough that only the gap matters, which holds for 63 mm

params.name: ic500.gap_mm
params.source: user 2026-11-13: electrode gap 10 mm

params.name: ic500.l_eff_cm
params.source: collection length along the beam = the electrode length, 50 mm (user, 2026-11-16, from the vendor figure of the split electrode: 50 mm along the beam, 63 mm across). The sigma is an allowance for fringe field and guard rings, which the figure does not show (the guarded CMC chamber's l_eff was 2.3 % longer than its plate); it stays at 3 % until a fringe-field run says otherwise. The sigma is relative (0.03 = 3 %), not in the row's unit

params.closes_with: say how the chamber is mounted; rerun wall_loss_ic500.py and wall_loss_fit_ic500.py, update ic500.wall_fit
params.name: ic500.plate_orientation
params.source: plates horizontal, E-vector along the plates (the MonC mounting); the wall-loss MC geometry

params.name: ic500.split_band_mm
params.source: height of the zig-zag split between the two electrode halves, 22 mm (user, 2026-11-16, vendor figure). A beam inside this band shares its current between the two halves by its position; the SUM of the two channels does not depend on position, a single channel does (flag per_channel_flux_depends_on_beam_position)

params.name: ic500.volts
params.source: user 2026-11-13: HV driven right now at 1.7 kV

params.name: ic500.wall_fit
params.source: signal wall loss fitted to the MC of analysis/wall_loss_ic500.py (horizontal plates, centred beam, 0.1 mm FWHM); the rounded fit is checked by analysis/wall_loss_fit_ic500.py. Order: E0, s, p

params.name: recomb.alpha_cm3_s
params.source: ion-pair recombination coefficient of air at 1 atm, a textbook value used for BOTH carriers, which overstates the loss in N2 where the negative carrier is a free electron

params.name: recomb.apply_to_best
params.source: whether the recombination correction is applied to the best estimate. True because an uncorrected recombination always understates the flux. Chosen in the 2026-11-14 plan; this reverses the earlier convention (old A19: the best estimate carries known, modelled corrections only, recombination goes to the high bound). Confirmed by the user on 2026-11-16 ("Yes, keep it")

params.name: recomb.mobility_cm2_vs
params.source: textbook ion mobility, used for BOTH carriers, which overstates the loss in N2 where the negative carrier is a free electron

params.name: spectrum.fractions
params.source: user, 2026-11-14: monochromators are fairly good at monochromating

params.name: sr570.electronics_rel
params.source: SR570 gain x V2F scale incl. loading, type B (ELECTRONICS_CONCLUSIONS.md; user 2026-11-13)

params.name: terms.density_rel
params.source: as MonP; the real P, T source for flowing N2 is open (A7)

params.closes_with: an edge scan (a foil K edge) at the working energy, giving the readback's real error
params.name: terms.energy_readback_rel
params.source: mono energy readback (user 2026-11-17, 'Add the term'): an assumed 0.1 % energy error (dE/E) times d ln(flux)/d ln E, which is at most 3.3 for this chamber (best estimate at 29.5 keV; 2.2 below 15 keV); carried as 0.4 %, the C-station value (calc/quality_slots.py SYMMETRIC_TERMS), which covers it. The E-station energy is the side-bounce mono

params.name: terms.mu_en_tables_rel
params.source: spread of NIST vs Chantler/Elam (physics_note 3.7); the MonP term reused for this chamber

params.name: terms.w_rel
params.source: spread of five sources, as a 1-sigma; the MonP term reused for this chamber

params.closes_with: a dark measured the same day
params.name: tetramm.dark_sigma_nA
params.source: residual dark offset after the caller's dark is subtracted: the E-station dark moved by about 1 nA from week to week (Experimenter note 2026-11-13)

params.closes_with: the order code and its accuracy table, or a calibration against a known current source
params.name: tetramm.gain_rel
params.source: gain accuracy placeholder: neither the manual's text nor the order code gives a figure

params.closes_with: the new settings log on the production host, from 2026-11-14 03:25 UTC
params.name: tetramm.range
params.source: range inferred as +-120 uA (RNG 0): signals of 0.2-6 uA were recorded unclipped; range, bias and offsets are not archived

params.closes_with: confirm whether the IOC offsets are in use during a measurement
params.name: tetramm.unit_a
params.source: unit of the IOC values at the E-station: nA (CurrentScale 1e9, Experimenter 2026-11-13); the unit field is empty

params.name: lane.k_flux
params.source: W_EV/(E_CHARGE*1e3) from fluxor.constants

params.name: lane.flag1_energy
params.source: calc/quality_slots.FLAG1_E_KEV: wall-loss band widens above 12.5 keV at the lowest density seen (informational, bit 1)

params.name: lane.flag2_recomb
params.source: calc/estation_lane.RECOMB_FLAG_FRACTION: bit 2, central recombination above 5 %

params.name: lane.flag4_pressure_age
params.source: bit 4: pressure not updated for 2 h (same rule as the C-station lanes)

params.name: lane.flag8_low_current
params.source: calc/estation_lane.LOW_CURRENT_NA: bit 8, net current below 50 nA (the TetrAMM noise term is not in the bounds; this flag covers it)

params.name: lane.flag16_energy_range
params.source: mono range the fit and tables are valid for: 4.9 to 30.5 keV (bit 16, alarm)

params.name: lane.flag32_raw_neg_margin
params.source: calc/estation_lane.RAW_NEG_MARGIN_NA: bit 32, raw sum below -5 nA

params.name: lane.flag32_full_scale_fraction
params.source: calc/estation_lane.FULL_SCALE_FRACTION: bit 32, a channel at or above 99 % of full scale (118800 nA)

params.name: lane.wall_band
params.source: calc/quality_slots.BAND, shared with the C-station lanes (analysis/wall_loss_fit.py)

params.name: lane.recomb_k_per_A
params.source: fluxor recombination at 1 uA, linear in current, capped at 0.5 (calc/estation_lane._generate)

params.name: lane.noise_threshold
params.source: 3 sigma of the two-channel current from the TetrAMM chain, rounded up to 0.1 nA (not in the live bounds)
